name: Dumbbell Single-Arm Reverse Curl
steps: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart and hold a dumbbell in one hand in front of your thigh with an overhand palm-down grip.
Keep your elbow tucked near your side and curl the dumbbell upward while keeping the back of your hand facing up.
Pause briefly at the top with your wrist flat and forearm engaged.
Lower the weight smoothly back to the starting position, and switch arms after completing one side.
tips: Keep your wrist straight instead of letting it bend backward as you lift.
Avoid swinging your shoulder forward or rocking your torso to gain momentum.
